behaviour: Unit-test Scene active-page element isolation, all-page accessors, replaceAllElements merge vs replaceAllPages, insertElement activePageId stamping, and Store multi-page snapshot integrity.
rules: 1. Test Scene with elements across multiple pages and verify getNonDeletedElements, getElementsIncludingDeleted, getElementsMapIncludingDeleted, getElement, and getSelectedElements filter to activePageId while getAllElementsIncludingDeleted, getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted, and getAllNonDeletedElements return all pages' elements.
2. Test Scene.insertElement stamps activePageId onto elements when activePageId !== DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and omits pageId when activePageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID without drawing extra randomId() calls.

3. Test Scene.replaceAllElements merges active-page updates while preserving other pages' elements in original order when replaceAllPages is false/omitted, and replaces the entire master array when replaceAllPages is true or when input elements span multiple pages.
4. Test Store.scheduleMicroAction and Store.commit preserve non-active pages' elements in snapshot.elements when active-page mutations occur.

sites.rule: Import Scene, Store, getElementPageId, newElement, and syncInvalidIndices for multi-page Scene unit tests.

tests.name: isolates active-page elements in Scene queries while exposing all elements via getAll*
tests.given: a Scene containing elements on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and on a second page page-2
tests.expect: getNonDeletedElements and getElementsIncludingDeleted return only the active page's elements and switching activePageId switches the returned elements while getAllNonDeletedElements returns both pages' elements

tests.name: stamps non-default activePageId on insertElement and omits pageId on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID
tests.given: a Scene on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and then switched to page-2
tests.expect: elements inserted on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID have pageId undefined and elements inserted on page-2 have pageId === 'page-2'

tests.name: merges active-page updates with other pages in replaceAllElements and supports replaceAllPages
tests.given: a Scene with elements on page-default and page-2
tests.expect: calling replaceAllElements with updated active-page elements preserves the other page's elements, and calling replaceAllElements with { replaceAllPages: true } replaces the entire master list

tests.name: preserves non-active page elements in Store snapshot across micro-actions
tests.given: a Scene and Store with elements on page-default and page-2
tests.expect: scheduling and committing a mutation on page-2 keeps page-default elements intact in store.snapshot.elements

behaviour: Integration-test default page initialization, PageTabBar UI and actions, tombstone deletion, per-page element isolation and viewport preservation when leaving a page, per-element-page undo/redo filing across immediate page switches, single-page visual and embedded-scene export, multi-page JSON round-trip and legacy restore, and cross-page search.
rules: 1. Test AC-1: mounting <Excalidraw /> initializes appState.pages with a single default page { id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: 'Page 1', scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 } }, appState.activePageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, and renders PageTabBar with 'Page 1' active and delete button disabled.

2. Test AC-2 and AC-3: clicking the add-page button creates 'Page 2' and activates it; inline rename via page-rename-input updates the tab name on Enter/blur, ignores empty whitespace, and cancels on Escape; move-left/move-right reorders pages while keeping activePageId unchanged; deleting a page when pages.length > 1 marks its elements isDeleted: true with bumped version (tombstones) and activates the nearest remaining neighbor while deleting the last remaining page is prevented.

3. Test AC-4 and AC-5: elements created on Page 1 and Page 2 are isolated on the canvas (h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements()), each page saves and restores its own scrollX, scrollY, and zoom when leaving and returning to the page, and undo/redo on Page 2 only undoes/redoes Page 2's changes without affecting Page 1's elements or undo stack.

4. Test cross-switch undo filing: edit an element on Page A, switch to Page B straight away before or around commit, and verify that undo on Page B does not undo Page A's edit while switching back to Page A and running undo undoes Page A's edit.

5. Test AC-6: exportToCanvas, exportToSvg, and exportToBlob on a multi-page scene render only the active page's elements, and when exportEmbedScene is true the embedded scene carries only the exported page's elements (without pageId) and no pages or activePageId.
6. Test AC-7: SearchMenu searches text and frame elements across all pages, shows page badges on multi-page matches, and selecting a match on another page switches activePageId to that page.

7. Test AC-8 and AC-9: serializeAsJSON and restore round-trip multi-page scenes (pages, activePageId, and per-element pageId), legacy payloads without pages or pageId restore to the single default page with zero extra randomId() calls, and orphaned element pageIds are reassigned to pages[0].id while cross-page bindings are stripped.

tests.name: initializes with a single default Page 1 and disables deleting the only page (AC-1)
tests.given: a freshly mounted Excalidraw component with no initialData.appState.pages
tests.expect: appState.pages has 1 page with id DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and name 'Page 1', activePageId is DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, and the delete button is disabled

tests.name: creates, renames, reorders, and tombstone-deletes pages via PageTabBar and actions (AC-2, AC-3)
tests.expect: adding pages creates Page 2 and Page 3, renaming updates the page name (or preserves it on empty input/Escape), reordering updates page order while preserving activePageId, and deleting an active page marks its elements isDeleted: true with bumped version and selects the nearest neighbor

tests.name: isolates elements and preserves per-page viewport and undo/redo history across page switches (AC-4, AC-5)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with elements and viewport changes on Page 1 and Page 2
tests.expect: switching pages saves outgoing scrollX/scrollY/zoom, swaps visible elements, and restores incoming scrollX/scrollY/zoom, and undo/redo on Page 2 only affects Page 2's elements while Page 1's undo stack remains intact

tests.name: files undo entries by the edited element's page when switching from page A to page B straight away (AC-5)
tests.given: an edit made on Page A followed immediately by switching to Page B before or during Store commit
tests.expect: undo on Page B does not undo Page A's edit, and switching back to Page A and invoking undo undoes the edit on Page A

tests.name: exports only the active page in visual exports and omits page list and pageId from embedded scenes (AC-6)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with a rectangle on Page 1 and an ellipse on Page 2
tests.expect: exportToSvg and exportToCanvas include only the active page's elements, and when exportEmbedScene is enabled the embedded scene contains only the active page's elements without pageId and omits pages and activePageId

tests.name: searches across all pages and switches to the matched element's page on selection (AC-7)
tests.given: a two-page drawing with text 'Alpha' on Page 1 and text 'Beta' on Page 2 while Page 1 is active
tests.expect: searching 'Beta' lists the match with Page 2's name and clicking the match switches activePageId to Page 2

tests.name: round-trips multi-page JSON and restores legacy and orphaned-pageId payloads cleanly (AC-8, AC-9)
tests.given: a multi-page scene serialized with serializeAsJSON, a legacy single-page payload without pages, and a payload with orphaned pageIds and cross-page bindings
tests.expect: restoring the serialized JSON preserves all pages, activePageId, and element pageIds; legacy payloads synthesize Page 1 and assign elements to DEFAULT_PAGE_ID; orphaned pageIds reassign to pages[0].id and cross-page bindings are stripped

behaviour: Test live collaboration page/element synchronization, encrypted Firebase room page list storage and reload, legacy peer fallback, and localStorage persistence across multiple pages.
rules: 1. Test AC-10: during collaboration in ExcalidrawApp, remote SCENE_INIT / SCENE_UPDATE payloads carrying pages and multi-page elements update local appState.pages and scene elements while keeping the local user's activePageId and viewport independent (unless the local user's active page was deleted remotely, in which case activePageId falls back to pages[0].id), and remote elements without pageId from legacy peers land on DEFAULT_PAGE_ID.

2. Test Firebase room page list persistence: saving a multi-page room via saveToFirebase encrypts and stores pagesIv and pagesCiphertext on the room document and loading via loadFromFirebase decrypts and returns the saved page list.

3. Test AC-11: saving to localStorage via LocalData / clearAppStateForLocalStorage and importing via importFromLocalStorage + restore preserves pages, activePageId, per-page scrollX/scrollY/zoom, and all pages' elements across reload.

style_from.reason: ExcalidrawApp and Collab test mocking and harness conventions

tests.name: synchronizes multi-page elements and page list in collaboration while keeping local activePageId independent (AC-10)
tests.given: a collaborating ExcalidrawApp instance receiving remote scene updates with added/renamed/deleted pages and legacy elements without pageId
tests.expect: remote pages and elements merge into local state without forcing a page switch unless the active page was deleted, and legacy elements without pageId default to DEFAULT_PAGE_ID

tests.name: encrypts and loads the room page list on the Firebase room document (AC-10)
tests.given: a collaborating room with multiple pages saved via saveToFirebase and reloaded via loadFromFirebase
tests.expect: the room document stores encrypted pagesIv and pagesCiphertext fields and loadFromFirebase decrypts and restores the page list alongside all pages' elements

tests.name: persists and restores multi-page state and elements in browser localStorage (AC-11)
tests.given: a multi-page scene saved to localStorage via LocalData
tests.expect: importing from localStorage and restoring recovers all pages, activePageId, per-page viewports, and elements on every page
